prompt: GraphQL FieldSelectionMap SelectedListValue elements allowed difference ListValue
answer:
`SelectedListValue` is more restrictive than GraphQL’s standard `ListValue`.

| Construct | Allowed elements |
|---|---|
| GraphQL `ListValue` | A list of zero or more `Value` elements. Each element may be any value literal or variable, including scalars, objects, or nested lists. |
| `SelectedListValue` | Exactly one `SelectedValue` element, or one nested `SelectedListValue`: `SelectedListValue ::= [ SelectedValue ] \| [ SelectedListValue ]`. |

A `SelectedValue` may itself be a `SelectedObjectValue`, so multiple fields can be selected within a single list element:

```graphql
parts[{ id, name }]
```

But multiple `SelectedValue` elements in the same list are invalid:

```graphql
parts[id, name]
```

Thus, `SelectedListValue` represents the selection applied to each item of an output list, rather than a general list of independently selected values. Nested list shapes must also match the output object’s list shape.
